properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 9 at 6:09PM MST until September 9 at 7:00PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
SVRTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southwestern Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 700 PM MST.

* At 609 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 8 miles southwest
of Tombstone, moving west at 5 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Sierra Vista, Whetstone, Tombstone, Charleston and Fairbank.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 near mile marker 308...and between mile markers 320 and 324.
Route 80 near mile marker 315. Route 92 near mile marker 322. Route
82 between mile markers 52 and 62.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds.

Wind damage with this storm will occur before any rain or lightning.
Do not wait for the sound of thunder before taking cover. Seek
shelter immediately inside a sturdy structure and stay away from
windows.

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued September 9 at 8:59PM EDT until September 9 at 9:30PM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
TORCTP

The National Weather Service in State College has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
North Central Cameron County in north central Pennsylvania...
Southeastern McKean County in north central Pennsylvania...
Southwestern Potter County in north central Pennsylvania...

* Until 930 PM EDT.

* At 859 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located near Betula, or 18 miles northeast of St. Marys, moving
east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

* This tornado will be near...
Betula around 900 PM EDT.
Keating Summit and Sizerville around 915 PM EDT.

Other locations impacted by the tornado include Austin.
properties.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.
